Mammary Paget disease is an adenocarcinoma that arises within the epidermis of the nipple and areola (nipple-areolar complex), starting at the nipple and extending to the areola/central subareolar region; it is anatomically anchored to the nipple-areolar complex rather than the general breast quadrants.
